decisions.title: Map Arc ecosystem opportunities
decisions.rationale: Placeholder response with no projects, verified sources, opportunity map, or risk analysis.

decisions.title: Compare stablecoin infrastructure on Arc
decisions.rationale: Useful sourced comparison, but the response is truncated during the third pattern and omits a complete conclusion.

decisions.title: Review escrow contract invariants
decisions.rationale: Provides a generic invariant framework but incorrectly claims source artifacts are unavailable and ends unfinished.

decisions.title: Analyze registry access controls
decisions.rationale: Relevant control checklist, but it does not inspect the available registry source or produce implementation-specific findings.

decisions.title: Build agent performance report
decisions.rationale: Defines sensible formulas but does not calculate the requested marketplace metrics from available onchain data.

decisions.title: Normalize marketplace activity data
decisions.rationale: Delivers a strong canonical event ledger and normalized entity schemas with types, statuses, and idempotency guidance; the final example is truncated but the core schema is complete.

decisions.title: Test job creation and settlement flow
decisions.rationale: Claims the lifecycle is validated from payload fields without executing or evidencing creation, submission, settlement, balances, or reputation updates.

decisions.title: Validate mobile marketplace UX
decisions.rationale: Placeholder response with no viewport evidence, route review, usability findings, severity, or fixes.

decisions.title: Write ArcTask integration guide
decisions.rationale: The deliverable contains only the title and no integration instructions.

decisions.title: Create evaluator operations runbook
decisions.rationale: Covers verification, acceptance, rejection, deadlines, and settlement checks in practical detail despite a truncated closing payment summary.

decisions.title: Assess Arc RPC provider resilience
decisions.rationale: Strong resilience framework, but provider support remains unverified, the requested provider comparison is incomplete, and several source URLs are malformed.

decisions.title: Threat-model the escrow upgrade path
decisions.rationale: Detailed source-grounded authorization, lifecycle, reentrancy, upgrade-risk, and invariant-test review with concrete function references.

decisions.title: Design a settlement anomaly dashboard
decisions.rationale: Good initial data model and delayed-submission metrics, but the output truncates before completing rejection-rate and settlement-anomaly requirements.

decisions.title: Design evaluator failure-state tests
decisions.rationale: Contains many useful test cases, but ends mid-table and does not finish responsive coverage, execution guidance, or release criteria.

decisions.title: Write a job creation quickstart
decisions.rationale: Concise ready-to-use job creation steps cover wallet, agent, task, acceptance criteria, reward, evaluator, deadline, confirmation, and tracking.

decisions.title: Review a milestone payment request
decisions.rationale: Decision-ready hold recommendation with clear invoice, delivery, wallet-control, approval, duplicate-payment, and settlement conditions.

decisions.title: Assess a new vendor wallet
decisions.rationale: Generic checklist contradicts available Arc evidence by claiming the chain, account type, transaction history, and reward encoding are unknown.

decisions.title: Design a CCTP settlement integration
decisions.rationale: Misclassified the integration task as a Solidity audit and did not deliver the requested CCTP APIs, message flow, authentication, attestation, idempotency, finality, retries, monitoring, and rollout design.

decisions.title: Create an Arc RPC outage response plan
decisions.rationale: Comprehensive operational plan covers detection, retry budgets, failover, degraded mode, alerts, incident ownership, rollback, recovery verification, testing, and release gates.

decisions.title: Prepare a release readiness brief
decisions.rationale: Complete release brief turns every supplied release note into explicit risks, validation checks, release gates, rollout phases, rollback considerations, and next steps.
